BLOCKER: Migration 0021 changes the `backlog_items` primary key to `(tenant_id,id)` but names only the traceability FK; there is no inventory/rebuild order for all FKs, indexes, unique constraints, and triggers referencing `backlog_items.id` — a missed dependent object fails migration or leaves invalid references.

`PF_BACKLOG_DB` default-on is global in `config/env-flags.json`, but backfill/parity cover only PF-SB and PF-GP; no per-scope gating is defined in `core/backlog.py` or the runtime contract, so non-target backlog scopes can become DB-authoritative without parity evidence.
MAJOR: `backlog_db_backfill.py` writes directly to PostgreSQL, bypassing edpsvc audit/authz; the audit claim covers only “existing edpsvc paths,” leaving backfilled or parity-corrected rows without an audit record.

Mode-resolution precedence between code default, `config/env-flags.json`, and `PF_BACKLOG_DB` is undefined; `coverage` lists “invalid mode” but no expected failure code or fail-closed behavior, so conflicting/invalid values can select the wrong authority.
`backup_restore` relies on EDP-23 for PITR/restore, but EDP-23 is absent from `dependencies` and `prerequisites`; preflight cannot verify availability of the backup/restore path it depends on.
Performance requirement “Cutover must not regress T1/T2 measured paths” has no benchmark, test, or evidence entry in `test_matrix`, `coverage`, or `ac_evidence`.
File-to-DB backfill tenant attribution is unspecified; `backlog_items` PK/RLS require `tenant_id`, but no mapping or validation from PF-SB/PF-GP file projections to tenant is defined.
Parity is count-only (“743/743, zero drift”); no compared fields, normalization, ordering, or tolerance are defined, so parity can pass while content differs.

`structure.yml` and `full-sweep.yml` are in scope, but no enumeration/update of existing file-mode jobs/tests to set `PF_BACKLOG_DB=off` is defined; the default flip can make unrelated CI require DB/edpsvc.
MINOR: `prerequisites` says “Migrations through 0021 applied” while `deployment_rollout` says “Apply 0021”; operator ordering is contradictory.
`scripts/dev/backlog_migration_preflight.py` is in `affected_files` but omitted from `review_scope.files`; no test or evidence covers its backup/lock abort logic.
`test-framework/tests/test_backlog_migrations.py` is in scope but not mapped to any AC, `test_matrix` entry, or evidence; 0021 schema/down assertions are unproven.
`backlog-db.yml` is not stated as a required PR check or branch-protection gate; AC-2 proves a job exists, not that it blocks merges.
NIT: `PF_BACKLOG_DB` is not added to `docs/GLOSSARY.md` despite CL-003 requiring terms to be defined before building.
SUMMARY: The design still has new integrity and scope-control blockers around the PK migration dependency surface and global default-on behavior.
Backfill audit, mode precedence, backup dependency, performance, tenant attribution, and parity semantics remain underspecified.
Not ready for Gate 1.5 until these gaps and the prior blockers are resolved with test/evidence mapping.
